name: GLCW Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Created from a battle-royal-tested trophy division, its first champion crowned with a little outside help he never admitted to needing.

name: GLCW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in a grueling defense settled by a single backdrop driver in the match's closing seconds.

name: GLCW Great Lakes Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in a Texas death match settled only after a rival promotion's own president interfered against the defending champion.

name: GLCW World Crown
epitaph: Crowned in a six-way elimination match its own promotion called the biggest night in its history, decided only after a fallen champion rose from a stretcher to reclaim the ring and finish what a title match had already tried to settle without him.

name: GLCW Iron Crown
epitaph: Settled twice across a single year in two-out-of-three-falls contests between the same two men, the second changing hands only when the challenger turned the champion's own finishing hold back on him.

name: GLCW Legacy Championship
epitaph: Defended once on the record against the very challenger who had already lost it, the champion's night saved only because the promotion's own rules refuse a title change on a count-out.
